svg.text: THE ATRIUM · open to the dome
STAFF ONLY: stair down to the supply closet
the flight tube: a ring walk round the atrium (kept)
two glass doors: food court ⇄ terrace

Red dots are doors. Each is one door, at the same place outside and inside. Grid = 3.5 m squares. Glass roof: the vault over both concourses, the dome over the atrium; terracotta hip roofs over the four corner blocks.
